title.zh: Bitcoin ETFs draw $2.4B in biggest inflow week since October 2025
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs draw $2.4B in biggest inflow week since October 2025

current_state.zh: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $2.39 billion in weekly net inflows — the strongest week since October 2025 and a 2026 record — lifting year-to-date flows to about $926 million as BTC pulled back from above $87,100, with Ether and XRP ETFs also attracting capital.
